description: Japanese consumption tax: whether you are taxable (base period sales over 10M JPY, specified period sales and wages both over 10M, or invoice registration; NTA No.6501) and the tax under the general method, simplified method (deemed purchase rates 90-40% by business type 1-6, base sales up to 50M, election required; No.6505), the 20% special rule (taxable periods including 2026-09-30) and the 30% rule for individuals in 2027-2028 (No.6498).
